action: TEST CELL (slice tail, spec #80/#85): author consolidated coverage over the slice's NET behavior — not per-cell internals; the per-cell red-first tests from gfb-1/2/3 already cover their branches (session-scoped hold release both directions + sessionless fallback in test_bee_cli.mjs; controlRoot idle-gate both directions in test_guards.mjs; refused-merge-preserves-mount, nested-mount clean merge, no-marker no-op, detached-HEAD preservation in test_worktree_store.mjs). The old code made step 3 impossible (the mount was already destroyed at step 1 and destroyed again on retry — the incident's exact complaint). REGEN not needed (no packages/bee source change) BUT the cell files list carries the manifest per repo law; if release_manifest --check reports drift you touched something you should not have.
